articles.title: DOLCHID: Dental Odontogenic Lesion CBCT and Histopathology Integrated Dataset
articles.keywords: CBCT; histopathology; ameloblastoma; odontogenic keratocyst; dentigerous cyst; dataset; segmentation masks
articles.abstract: The DOLCHID dataset comprises 262 paired CBCT volumes and H&E histopathology slides, including 92 cases of odontogenic keratocyst (KCOT), 72 cases of ameloblastoma (AME), and 44 cases of dentigerous cyst (DC). It provides segmentation masks and annotations for odontogenic lesions, serving as a benchmark for AI-based diagnostic research in dental imaging.

articles.title: Classification of Ameloblastoma, Periapical Cyst, and Chronic Suppurative Osteomyelitis with Semi-Supervised Learning
articles.authors: Liang, B., Qin, H., Nong, X., et al.
articles.keywords: ameloblastoma; periapical cyst; chronic suppurative osteomyelitis; CBCT; WaveletFusion-ViT; semi-supervised learning
articles.abstract: This study proposes a WaveletFusion-ViT model for automatic diagnosis using CBCT panoramic images. The model employs semi-supervised learning to classify ameloblastoma (AM), periapical cyst (PC), and chronic suppurative osteomyelitis (CSO), achieving 91.47% accuracy with less than 20% labeled data.

articles.title: Improvement in Diagnostic Accuracy of Ameloblastoma and Odontogenic Keratocyst on CBCT by Artificial Intelligence
articles.authors: Chai, Z.-K., Mao, L., Chen, H., et al.
articles.keywords: ameloblastoma; odontogenic keratocyst; CBCT; convolutional neural network; CNN; diagnostic accuracy
articles.abstract: The study used a convolutional neural network (CNN) to differentiate ameloblastoma (AME) from odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) on CBCT images. The model was trained with 178 AME and 172 OKC images, achieving 84.6% accuracy, surpassing the diagnostic accuracy of oral and maxillofacial surgeons.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence Mechanism for Cystic Lesion Detection in CBCT Images
articles.authors: Esmaeilyfard, R., Esmaeeli, N., Paknahad, M.
articles.journal: Journal of Stomatology, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery
articles.keywords: cystic lesions; dentigerous cyst; periapical cyst; CBCT; deep learning; AI detection
articles.abstract: This article evaluates an AI mechanism for detecting cystic lesions. The dataset contained 150 samples, including 50 dentigerous cysts (DC) and 50 periapical cysts (PC). The deep learning model showed high accuracy (above 90%) in detecting and classifying these cysts.

articles.title: Differential Diagnosis by Computed Tomography of Ameloblastoma and Odontogenic Keratocyst Using a Convolutional Neural Network
articles.keywords: ameloblastoma; odontogenic keratocyst; CT; convolutional neural network; differential diagnosis; CNN
articles.abstract: This study focuses on the differential diagnosis between ameloblastoma and odontogenic keratocyst, using a CNN to classify the lesions from computed tomography images.

articles.title: Diagnosis of Cystic Lesions Using Panoramic and Cone-Beam Computed Tomography Images with Deep Learning Neural Network
articles.authors: Lee, J.H., Kim, D.H., Jeong, S.N.
articles.keywords: cystic lesions; panoramic radiography; CBCT; deep learning; neural network; diagnosis
articles.abstract: The study applies deep learning neural networks to diagnose cystic lesions, combining panoramic and CBCT images, demonstrating the potential of the technique for this purpose.

articles.title: Automated Detection of Cysts and Tumors of the Jaws in Panoramic Radiographs by Deep Learning
articles.keywords: cysts; tumors; jaws; panoramic radiographs; deep learning; automated detection

articles.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence through Graph Theory by Generalized Social Network Analysis-Based Classifier
articles.keywords: explainable AI; graph theory; social network analysis; classifier; NLP; tabular data
articles.abstract: This paper proposes GSNAc, a supervised visual machine learning classifier based on graph theory and social network analysis (SNA). The model transforms tabular data into a network where samples are nodes and edges reflect pairwise similarities. The raw network graph is enriched and simplified to extract a visualizable Graph Classifier Model (GCM). Extended from the prior SNAc model for time-series data, GSNAc works with any tabular data including numerical and categorical features. NLP researchers can convert sentences into adjacency matrices based on word co-occurrence and apply graph similarity techniques for word similarity prediction. The model achieves competitive accuracy while providing inherent explainability through graph visualization.
